Made up for testing: an export from a small beetle collection.

- `specimens.csv`: one row per catalogued specimen (or lot), with the collecting event repeated on
  each row.
- `determinations.csv`: every determination, the current one marked; one name has "cf." and one
  "aff.".
- `tissues.csv`: a tissue sample taken from one specimen, with when and by whom.

The export has no institution or collection codes. The mapping uses the made-up data holder's
answer to the question about them: institution NHMD, collection COL for the specimens and TIS for
the tissue.
